name: systemap
description: The systemap skill makes a system map from source facts and examined claims. Reader text obeys the configured writing profile: plain or ASD-STE100.

command.title: systemap command
command.description: The command that starts systemap, for example "uv run systemap" or "uvx systemap". The plugin adds "live --port 0 --json --no-watch" to this command.

autostart.title: Start the live map with each session
autostart.description: If true, the live map starts when a session starts in a systemap repository. The live map runs the Python code in map/model.py of that repository. Set true only if you trust each repository that you open.
